assessment: Official Budgam district pages provide local Khansahib revenue-administration evidence and link public land-record procedures to the J&K Revenue Department. The current JK-Revenue frontend was retrieved and inspected, but its discovered API surface is authenticated administrative functionality. The public LRIS host timed out from this environment, and no anonymous safe parcel polygon or native parcel ID was obtained.
registryAssessment: Local registry/revenue custody is evidenced by the official Budgam district Revenue Online Services page, its Khansahib SDM listing, and direct links to Fard, Aks Masavi/Latha, mutation, demarcation, Girdawari, Jamabandi, encumbrance and Land Passbook procedures. This is local service evidence, not proof of citywide public vector coverage.
